sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: In the digital age, filing personal tax returns online has become the most credible and realistic means for an individual to furnish tax compliance. The Government of India has facilitated the functioning of personal tax return filing in India through the introduction of simple tax e-filing portals that help eliminate paperwork and errors. Be you an employee on a salary, a self-employed professional, or a freelancer, income tax return filing has now become just a matter of a few clicks.

A professional personal tax return filing company such as Services Plus will ensure accuracy and full compliance with the Income Tax Act while maximizing your eligible deductions and helping you avoid costly mistakes.

Personal tax return filing online comprises the declaration of an individual's income, tax liabilities, deductions, and exemptions to the Income Tax Department for a specific financial year. This is for the purpose of the authorities assessing taxable income, i.e., to determine if any taxes are payable or if any refund is due to the taxpayer. In fact, online filing from Services plus will be much quicker and more transparent and can be accessed from any location in India or abroad.
The following categories of taxpayers must file an income tax return:
Taxable income exceeds the basic exemption limit.
For those Below 60 old—₹2,50,000 per annum.
For those 60-80 years old, ₹300,000 per annum.
For those Above 80 years old, ₹5,00,000 per annum.
Also, if one has foreign income or holds assets abroad.
Companies/firms also must file income tax returns, even if they have zero income.
Where tax has been deducted at source under any section, and the person wants to claim a refund.
Carry-forward of losses from the previous assessment years.
It is encouraged that voluntary personal tax return filing online should be performed, even if not required, because of its utility as financial proof while applying for a loan and travel visa.
Convenience: Online, you can fill out your tax return at your own pace and from anywhere with Internet access.
Saves Time: Online personal tax return filing in India is generally quicker, making conventional filing methods a waste of time in comparison.
